route: Built-in ImageGen; concept-only. Reference image generated in this task; no personal sample media.

primary.brief: Image-first PicForge photo processing workbench. Full desktop 1536×1024. Neutral white chrome, neutral gray image mat, graphite typography, restrained forest green accents. Flat file rows at left, aligned before/after photo preview in center, output inspector at right, a fixed export bar. Preserve compression/global-per-image settings, resize semantics, compare and zoom. No marketing hero, gradients, glass, decorative cards or invented features. Architectural image and file values are illustrative, not performance evidence.

Create a fresh standalone LIGHT desktop empty-state screenshot, 1536x1024, same full screen grid and header as reference. Header: 'PicForge', tabs '图片压缩' active thin green underline, 'Android 动态照片', 'iOS 实况照片', language and theme on far right. This proposes a first visit directly into the useful compression workspace instead of the old marketing home. Left file column title '文件' and '+ 添加', below one quiet message '尚未添加图片'; no fake rows or decorative images. Central neutral-gray canvas with four small subtle crop-corner marks defining a spacious drop target, NOT a giant rounded card. Center heading 24px '添加图片，开始处理', short body '拖放文件到这里，或直接粘贴图片', single dark forest rectangular button '选择图片', tiny secondary line '支持常见图片格式'. Right inspector same as reference: '输出设置', scope '全部图片', format JPEG, quality 75, 调整尺寸 off and disabled dimension fields, 高级设置 collapsed. Use pale gray active states, NOT large green filled scope tabs; green strongest only the import button. Bottom status bar left '文件仅在本机处理', right disabled light-gray '导出文件'. Elegant intentional whitespace and legible professional utility typography. Keep reference proportions except slightly narrow the empty file sidebar to give the central workspace more room.

The reference is a generated visual anchor. Preserve its typography, neutral white/gray palette, quiet thin separators, flat queue and continuous three-column workbench. Main accent deep forest #245946. No gradients, glass, glow, bento, decorative badges, extra product features. This is illustrative data, not a real performance result.
Header same PicForge square P and wordmark. Tabs '图片压缩', 'Android 动态照片' ACTIVE with thin green underline, 'iOS 实况照片', language '简体中文' and theme icon at right. Left queue title '文件 2', '+ 添加'. Two flat file rows: selected 'courtyard-01.jpg' with generated architecture thumbnail, status '已完成'; second 'coast-02.jpg' status '待提取'. No fake per-file cards. Central flexible viewer title 'courtyard-01', then side-by-side pair previews with exact labels '原始照片 · JPG' and '原始视频 · MP4'. Both previews show the same elegant minimalist concrete courtyard/trees/natural light from the reference, illustrative no people. Video has play button and compact seek control '0:00 / 0:03'. Images preserve their natural proportions; no artistic overlay on photo. Right inspector title '输出文件'. Two flat result groups separated by whitespace/thin line: 'JPG 照片', '6.9 MB', understated outlined action '下载 JPG'; 'MP4 视频', '1.5 MB', action '下载 MP4'. Below a quiet text-only explanation '保留原始字节' and smaller '直接提取，不重新编码'. No quality slider, no codec picker, no resize, no frame-rate setting, no global/per-image toggle, no progress predictions. No duplicated download actions under center previews. Footer left '文件仅在本机处理', center '1 个已完成 · 1 个待提取', right two clear differently weighted actions: secondary outlined '提取待处理文件' and primary forest '导出已完成文件'. Keep exactly one strongest primary action. Broad neutral image mat, clean professional spacing, deliberate Chinese control typography. Same product as reference, adapted to the extraction task, not a re-skin of compression controls.
